title: Check PNG structure
responsibility: Validate PNG headers, chunk checksums and ordering and collect compressed image data.

inputs.name: hubPngChunks.bytes
inputs.description: PNG file bytes passed to the structural parser. The parser accepts lengths from 45 through 33,554,432 bytes, requires the PNG signature and valid chunk CRCs, enforces its chunk ordering rules, and rejects zero or over-32,000,000-pixel dimensions and streams exceeding 10,000 chunks.

outputs.name: hubPngChunks
outputs.description: State returned when parsing reaches a valid terminal IEND chunk. It contains the parsed IHDR fields, IDAT payload byte slices, palette entry count, transparency indicator, and parser flags; input is limited to 32 MiB and 10,000 chunks.

errors.name: Hub PNG artifact-corrupt
errors.description: Rejected PNG structure calls hubFail() with its default code, throwing an Error with name Error, code artifact-corrupt, and message Harness artifact unavailable.
